auftrag: Read the newspaper report. Then solve five puzzles.

saetze: Silver Compass found – double agent caught!
Yesterday evening, Agent Wren found the Silver Compass in a locker at the Blue Teapot café in Brighton.
The compass was wrapped in a green cloth, but Wren had told only one trainee about the cloth.
Later, at the Academy, Mr Hale told everybody that the thief had wrapped the compass in a green cloth.
Nobody else could know that, because only Wren and the trainee had seen it.
Quietly, Agent Wren asked the police to follow him.
At six o'clock Pidge the pigeon followed Mr Hale to a bridge near the station, and there the police arrested him.
He had planned to sell the compass to a collector for a lot of money.
A spokesperson for the Academy said that the trainee's careful reading had saved the day.

raetsel.frage: What is the best summary of the report?
optionen: Sam wrote a story about a green cloth.
The police lost the Silver Compass in Brighton.
Mr Hale stole the compass and was caught because of a detail only the thief knew.
raetsel.hilfe1: Read the whole report. What is the big news?
raetsel.hilfe2: Look at the sentence that begins: Nobody else could know that.

raetsel.frage: Tap the sentence that explains why Mr Hale's words were a mistake.
raetsel.hilfe2: It is the second sentence of the second paragraph.

raetsel.frage: Why did Agent Wren ask the police to follow Mr Hale quietly?
optionen: She wanted to catch him when he met the buyer.
She wanted to ask him for a train ticket.
She was afraid of the pigeon.
raetsel.hilfe1: Think: why do you follow somebody quietly?
raetsel.hilfe2: Mr Hale wanted to sell the compass to a collector.

raetsel.frage: Put the events in the right order. What happened first?
items: Mr Hale talked about the green cloth.
Wren asked the police to follow him.
Pidge followed Mr Hale to a bridge.
raetsel.hilfe1: Read the report from top to bottom.
raetsel.hilfe2: The arrest is the last event.

raetsel.frage: Put the parts in the right order. It is a sentence from the report.
raetsel.hilfe1: The sentence starts with the time.
raetsel.hilfe2: After "Pidge" comes the word that tells you what Pidge did.
